headline: LKP Securities technical analyst Vatsal Bhuva sees potential rebounds for Swiggy and HDFC Bank despite broader market downside risks
hook: Downside risks persist for Nifty and Bank Nifty
summary: LKP Securities analyst Vatsal Bhuva warns of continued downside risks for the Nifty and Bank Nifty indices. However, he identifies potential price rebounds for Swiggy up to Rs 190 and HDFC Bank, noting they lack a confirmed trend reversal yet. He also recommends Oriental Hotels and Apollo Hospitals based on improving technical setups. Indian retail investors tracking index movements and these specific equities should note these technical outlooks before making trading decisions.
why_it_matters: Technical outlooks guide short-term trades in major Nifty stocks.

headline: Indian Hotels and Oriental Hotels rally up to 6% on Q2 demand hopes
hook: Stronger demand expected after a soft Q1
summary: Shares of Indian Hotels and Oriental Hotels gained up to 6% following expectations of a strong second quarter from brokerage Axis Securities. The sector faced pressure in Q1 due to the US-Iran conflict, but recovery is anticipated. Analysts attribute the outlook to improving demand in metro cities and upcoming events like the BRICS Summit. Indian retail investors with exposure to hospitality stocks can track Q2 earnings for recovery confirmation.
whats_next: Q2 earnings announcements for hotel companies
why_it_matters: Hospitality stocks rally on expected Q2 recovery.
winners_losers: Hotel operators gain / Q1 laggards recover
